samples.evidence: Fifty-seven adolescents were randomly assigned to receive IPT-AST or SC using a table of random numbers. To ensure enough adolescents in the IPT-AST groups, the random number table was generated so that approximately two-thirds of adolescents in each school would be randomized to IPT-AST. Thirty-six adolescents were randomized to IPT-AST and 21 to SC.
